summary: A site for a podcast or audio show: the newest episode in a player on the home page, a searchable episode archive, the hosts, follow links and guest suggestions, and an episode page with chapters, a synced transcript and show notes.

pages.purpose: Let a visitor press play within seconds, then browse episodes, meet the hosts and follow the show.

sections.purpose: The show name and one-line pitch beside the newest episode in a player, with the episode count.
fields: Newest episode: number, title, guest, duration, audio file
sections.notes: In the hero the player can show the line being spoken as a caption; that caption region should not be aria-live (it would talk over the audio).

sections.purpose: Every episode: search by title, guest or summary, a topic filter, rows that open into notes.
alternatives: blog-list: card list when each episode has its own artwork
empty-state: when a search matches nothing, offering to clear it
fields: Per episode: number, title, guest, date, duration, topic, summary, link to the episode page
sections.notes: Diacritics-insensitive search; live count of matching episodes in a polite region.

fields: Host name, role, short bio, photo with alt text

sections.purpose: How and where the show is recorded, beside a photo.
Ways to follow: copy the RSS feed, open a podcast app, get episodes by email.
alternatives: cta: a single band with one action
sections.notes: Copying the feed confirms in a status message. Prefer generic labels and the feed URL over a row of third-party logos.

sections.purpose: Suggest a guest: who, why and how you know them.
alternatives: form-01: a custom form with a relation-to-guest choice
fields: Fields: guest name, relation to them, why, your email
Topics the show is looking for

pages.purpose: The full archive on its own page when there are many episodes or seasons.

sections.purpose: Searchable, filterable list grouped by season, paged.
fields: Episodes with season, number, title, guest, date, duration, topic

pages.purpose: One episode: listen with chapters, follow the transcript, and read the notes, mentions and credits.

sections.purpose: Episode number, title, guest, date, duration and a summary.
The full player: chapter markers on the scrubber, a chapter list, speed and skip controls, and the transcript that follows playback.
fields: Transcript with speaker and start time per line
sections.notes: Clicking a chapter or a transcript line jumps there; the current line is marked with aria-current; 'follow along' can be turned off. The scrubber is a keyboard-operable slider with an accessible name and a value in minutes and seconds.

sections.purpose: Show notes in tabs: what was mentioned (with links), any extras that go with the episode, and credits.
Other episodes to listen to next.
fields: Two or three related or recent episodes

content: Show name, one-line pitch and cover art
Episodes: number, season, title, guest, date, duration, topic, summary and audio file
Chapter titles with start times per episode
Show notes: mentions with links, extras and credits
RSS feed URL and the podcast apps it is listed in
Guest-suggestion topics and the address suggestions go to
Email signup details if episodes are sent by email

styles.name: late-night studio
styles.why: Dark by default, a glass player over a soft rippling shape, a warm saffron-like accent and a waveform that rises bar by bar. Suits conversational and culture shows.

styles.name: radio bulletin
styles.why: Light, compact and businesslike, with long episode lists; for interview, news and industry podcasts.

pitfalls: No transcript: publish one per episode (accessibility and search), synced or at least timestamped.
A scrubber or waveform that only works with a mouse; it must be a keyboard slider with an accessible name and value.
Live regions that announce every caption line over the audio; keep the spoken-line caption silent to screen readers.
Episode pages without the audio file, date and duration, or a broken RSS feed link.
Third-party player embeds that load trackers before the visitor presses play.
Guest suggestion form without a privacy note, collecting more than needed.
